title: Open-Prediction Resolution Queue
dataSources: Forecasts (`prediction:forecast`), resolved outcomes (`prediction:outcome`), personal bets (`bet:personal`), calibration scores (`calibration:score`), Brier scores (`brier:score`).
app: Personal forecasting and calibration — a private prediction journal of dated forecasts about your own life, resolved outcomes, and calibration / Brier scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prediction:forecast status=open
| eval days_to_resolve=round((resolve_by-now())/86400,1)
| where days_to_resolve<7
| table question confidence resolve_by days_to_resolve
| sort days_to_resolve
description: Lists predictions whose resolution date is coming up so you remember to score them honestly and on time.
value: Unresolved forecasts quietly rot; a resolution queue keeps your track record complete and trustworthy.
implementation: Ingest open forecasts into `index=personal`; surface those due to resolve soon.
visualization: Table of predictions due to resolve this week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds you which of your predictions are due to be settled soon, so you always keep an honest score.
